actions.action: Scrape off top 1-2 cm of moldy soil and top up with fresh potting mix
Check soil and water only when top few cm are dry, watering thoroughly
Check pot has drainage hole and isn't sitting in standing water
If no drainage hole, repot into draining container or use as cachepot with nursery pot
Move plant to spot with more light and airflow
Remove dead, yellowed leaves including one on soil
Check soil smell and stem bases for rot
If rot signs, lift plant, trim mushy roots and repot in fresh mix
Report watering frequency, drainage and light to commenters

reason: The answer correctly identifies surface mold from overly wet soil, and its main advice to replace the moldy soil and cut back moisture closely matches the poster's soil change, with nothing harmful.
